Core Active Vocabulary (8 items):

breakfast — the first meal of the day. Example: I have bread for breakfast.
lunch — the meal in the middle of the day. Example: At lunch I eat a salad.
dinner — the main meal in the evening. Example: We have dinner at seven.
bread — a baked food made from flour. Example: I buy bread every morning.
coffee — a hot brown drink made from beans. Example: I drink coffee in the morning.
tea — a hot drink made from leaves. Example: She drinks tea with milk.
soup — a hot liquid food. Example: The soup is salty.
salad — a cold dish of raw vegetables. Example: I eat a salad for lunch.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I have ... for breakfast.
• I drink ... in the morning.
• She eats ... for lunch.
• We have dinner at seven.
• What do you have for breakfast?

The third person -s is clear: eats /iːts/, drinks /drɪŋks/.

Grammar focus: Verbs 'eat' and 'drink' + Present Simple Habitual.
Use eat and drink with the present simple for habits: I eat bread for breakfast. I drink coffee in the morning. Add -s with he, she and it: She drinks tea.
